cover.title: 5 niche ways to become the founder gdpr can't touch

inner.title: keep a processing record
inner.body: a record lists what personal data you process, why, who gets it and how long. the under 250 staff exemption barely exists, customer management alone triggers it.

inner.title: your vendors' leaks count
inner.body: a dpa makes vendors act only on your instructions and delete data after. in 2025 the cnil fined one €1 million for keeping 46 million users' data.

inner.title: collect less, purge automatically
inner.body: the cnil says collect only data that is adequate, relevant and necessary for the purpose. data you never collected is data you can never leak.

inner.title: the 72 hour clock
inner.body: the edpb says notify your regulator within 72 hours of becoming aware, unless risk is unlikely. every breach must be documented anyway, even unreported ones.

inner.title: answer within one month
inner.body: a user asking for their data gets a free copy within one month. in 2025 the cnil made 14 decisions against firms failing rights requests.

it's a paper trail.
